style.variety: natural, fluent Modern Standard Arabic (RTL; keep Latin-script terms and URLs as-is inline)
style.loanwords_text: Use the Arabic terms of this glossary (سلسلة الكتل, رمز, عقد ذكي, محفظة); keep a term in English only where its entry says keep English (note, faucet). Names of brands, products, organisations and protected terms stay in Latin script (Zcash, Zebra, Zkool).
writing_rules: Address the reader in the singular (أنت) everywhere, in tutorials and technical pages alike.
Never use Eastern Arabic digits (٠-٩); write 1,000 with a comma.
Never put English in brackets inside a Markdown link label.
Never add the English in brackets to a heading or a menu label; give it in the body text instead. Use round brackets ( ), never square brackets, for the English.
Before a Latin-script name, write a one-letter prefix with a tatweel and a space (لـ Zcash, بـ Zebra); never change the name itself.
Write DAO as المنظمة المستقلة اللامركزية (DAO) at its first use on a page, then DAO.
Arabic abbreviations such as إلخ take no full stop; technical acronyms (ZEC, ZIP, URL, API) stay in Latin script.

nullifier.notes: الترجمة تشرح وظيفته: قيمة تمنع إنفاق نفس الملاحظة مرتين.

note.context: a Zcash note is a shielded unit of value held by a shielded address, not a written remark (ملاحظة)
note.notes: «ملاحظة» تعني تعليقًا مكتوبًا، وهذا مستبعد صراحةً في التعريف، وليس لوحدة القيمة المحمية مقابل عربي متداول، فيبقى المصطلح Note بالإنجليزية.

staking.context: التخزين here means locking coins to help secure a network and earn rewards (staking), not data storage

changelog.summary: Imported from the runner's hand-written prompt_head_ar.txt: language variety, loanword rule and the node rendering, approved by the steward as legacy prompt-head rules.

Native review by @ronniecross535 (selected by Zcash Arabia), PR #2664: glossary (62 terms, 8 style answers) and menus. Arabic terms over loanwords (سلسلة الكتل, منصات التداول), note and faucet kept in English, singular أنت, Western digits, «» quotes, English in brackets at first use. Steward alignments with his own menu notes: dashboard لوحة المعلومات, faucet in English, visualizer أداة العرض المرئي, custodial وصائي, brand الهوية البصرية; brackets moved out of the pool/proof/memo targets; Arabic plural and construct forms added.
